SS51.name: 裂空皇带鱼
SS51.form: a very long slender ribbon-like body, a small head with a blunt snout, a single tapering dorsal crest running the full length of the back, a pair of short trailing pelvic filaments
SS51.fins: a continuous dorsal crest of evenly spaced rays, a tiny fan-shaped tail fin
SS51.markings: a faint line of luminous pores along the flank, a single streak splitting the dorsal crest

SS52.name: 渊眼巨鲨
SS52.form: a torpedo-shaped body with angular faceted flank plates, a long pointed snout, a single large eye set high on the head, five gill slits
SS52.fins: a tall triangular dorsal fin, a crescent tail fin with a long upper lobe
SS52.markings: a single luminous ring encircling each eye, a sparse line of pores along the flank

SS53.name: 陨落鲸
SS53.form: a massive rounded body, a broad blunt head, a row of ventral throat grooves, thin ridged jaw edges
SS53.fins: a small set-back dorsal fin, wide horizontal tail flukes
SS53.markings: a sparse scatter of luminous pores along the flank, a faint ring pattern around the eye

SS54.name: 原初海蛇
SS54.form: a long cylindrical band-like body with subtle ringed segmentation, a small blunt head, a wide gaping mouth, a ring of short recurved teeth
SS54.fins: a continuous low dorsal fin joined to the tail fin
SS54.markings: closely stacked faint ring bands along the body, an eroded fringe along the belly line

SS55.name: 星陨巨鱿
SS55.form: a large slender tapered mantle with faintly faceted panels, a broad head with two large eyes, eight arms and two long tentacles
SS55.fins: a pair of broad triangular fins spanning the rear of the mantle
SS55.markings: a sparse scatter of luminous points across the mantle, a faint ring around each eye

SS56.name: 虚空水母王
SS56.form: a wide translucent bell with faintly faceted radial ribs, a scalloped bell margin, four long trailing oral arms, a fringe of evenly spaced fine tentacles
SS56.markings: a ring of evenly spaced luminous pores around the bell margin, a faint cross pattern on the bell roof

SS57.name: 陨铁巨口鲨
SS57.form: a stout torpedo-shaped body with angular faceted plates, a long pointed snout, an enormous gaping mouth, five gill slits
SS57.fins: a tall triangular dorsal fin, long angular pectoral fins
SS57.markings: a sparse line of luminous pores along the flank, faint crater-like pits scattered on the back

SS58.name: 星蚀鳐王
SS58.form: a broad diamond-shaped disc with crisp bevelled wing panels, a short blunt snout, a long thin whip-like tail with a serrated spine
SS58.fins: wide angular pectoral wings, a low fin fold along the tail
SS58.markings: a faint eclipse ring centred on the disc, a sparse arc of luminous points along each wing edge

SS59.name: 陨光海龙
SS59.form: a sinuous slender body with faintly faceted ring segments, a long tapered snout, a pair of small swept-back horns
SS59.fins: a low continuous dorsal crest, a pair of long ribbon-like trailing tendrils
SS59.markings: a row of evenly spaced luminous nodes along the spine, a faint halo behind the head

SS60.name: 陨铁鲹
SS60.form: an elongated laterally compressed body with crisp bevelled edges, a steep forehead, a pointed snout, a terminal mouth
SS60.fins: a dorsal fin with a short spiny front section, a deeply forked tail fin
SS60.markings: a faint line of luminous pores along the flank, a single spot at the base of the tail
